description: Support matrix for the Mermaid-to-Excalidraw fork. target is the desired end state; baseline is the current regression guard.

cases.definition:
flowchart LR
  A[Ideazione] --> B[Produzione]
  B --> C[Distribuzione]

cases.definition:
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as Utente
  participant A as App
  U->>A: Richiesta
  A-->>U: Risposta

cases.definition:

    +String nome
